paper_title: The cholesterol, high-density lipoprotein, and glucose index and its derivatives related to obesity and inflammation as novel metabolic markers for predicting new-onset cardiovascular-liver-metabolic multimorbidity: A prospective cohort study
study_design: Prospective observational analysis of the 2011 and 2015 CHARLS waves; baseline-index exposures and binary outcome ascertainment at follow-up; logistic regression, restricted cubic splines, and apparent ROC evaluation.
evidence_type: Longitudinal observational association and unvalidated, in-sample discrimination
claim: A prospective CHARLS analysis identified incident, surrogate-defined cardiovascular–liver–metabolic multimorbidity at follow-up.
context: Chinese community-dwelling adults without baseline CLMM; component conditions were evaluated at baseline and the follow-up wave, rather than using exact onset dates.
reported_evidence: [{"label":"Analytic participants","value":"6,534 adults aged 45 years or older"},{"label":"Exposure and outcome waves","value":"2011 baseline and 2015 follow-up"},{"label":"Incident CLMM","value":"406 participants; 6.2%"},{"label":"Outcome definition","value":"At least two of CVD, type 2 diabetes, and LAP-based suspected MASLD"}]
source_locator: Methods: Study population and Outcome assessment (jdi70462-sec-0007; jdi70462-sec-0009); Results 3.1 (jdi70462-sec-0013); Figure 1; Table 1
scope_does_not_establish: ["A causal effect of CHG, obesity, or inflammation on multimorbidity.","Imaging- or biopsy-confirmed MASLD in every participant.","Hazard ratios, exact onset timing, or a time-to-event prediction model.","Independent internal or external validation, clinical net benefit, treatment efficacy, or a validated clinical cut-off."]
limitations: ["Residual confounding and observational design prevent causal inference.","Exact component-disease onset dates were unavailable; logistic ORs cannot be interpreted as hazards or incidence rates.","The MASLD component used an LAP-based suspected phenotype and may be misclassified; metabolic components overlap conceptually with the exposure indices.","The ROC analyses used the same analysis sample without internal or external validation, so apparent AUCs may be optimistic.","Single baseline exposure measurements, substantial complete-data selection, medication changes, correlated comparisons, and exploratory subgroup analyses limit interpretation.","Generalizability beyond Chinese adults aged at least 45 years requires independent evaluation."]
